title: Semantic Webcam — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Semantic Webcam's rich face: card 03 live where the line of iterations names it, its pipeline walked on a still where the page says how it works, and the carried question measured where the page keeps its lost branches, with the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: Character Multiply Cam · card 03, the anchor, live
pieces.caption: The anchor on your own face. Brightness picks the glyph; whole words fill the mid-tone runs; the highlights are white tiles with black letters. **g** swaps words for blocks, **space** freezes. The camera grant for this card is Loudon's, from 2026-10-21; nothing is recorded.

pieces.by: the Maker · canvas · card 03's engine on a still
pieces.title: the ramp · card 03's pipeline, walked up on a still
pieces.caption: Five steps on the Grace Hopper still (or soft waves): a grid of greys, the ramp, words into runs, smoothing under a modelled camera noise, and the test. Squinting one cell, the drawn frame follows the source at r +0.87, the shuffled control at −0.01. But six evenly spaced greys, one per tier, score +0.98 and the word band left empty still +0.69, so that number measures the tiers. Inside the word band it is +0.03: 03 selects by light and draws every letter at one brightness, where the section says it multiplies.

verdicts.why: Its headline bands are 03's 24x32 ink box, not a drawn cell: as 03 draws (type 1.22x the cell) letter cells read back 0.15-0.34 and letter-punched tiles 0.69-0.87, not 0.11-0.23 and 0.77-0.89, and light = 1 - ink ignores the tile tint and 0.92 alpha. Measure ink in the drawn cell (or label every number as box ink) and read both bands off the drawn frame, then carry the numbers into the caption, step 5 and offer 3; the flat curve and faint in-band tone stand.

pieces.title: legibility band · is legibility a band of light?
pieces.caption: One letter is one grey: drawn as 03 draws it, a capital covers 0.12–0.38 of its cell. Read back off the drawn Hopper frame, letter cells sit at 0.15–0.34 of full light and white tiles with a letter punched in at 0.69–0.87, two bands; the tiles carry 45% of the frame's light. Then the test: inside 03's word band the drawn light stays flat (r +0.03), words picked by ink lift it to +0.23, light alone to +0.53.

offers.what: The section says 'the camera-luminance × character-ink multiply is literally a Convolution-flavored blend'. Card 03 doesn't multiply. A cell's light selects a tier, and every word letter is drawn at one fixed brightness (alpha 0.94, 03:260). 03 fills an ink table but never reads it: ink() at 03:124 has no caller. Measured on the Hopper still (squint 1 cell): inside the word band r is +0.03 and drawn light rises 0.03 per unit of source light. A literal multiply would give the band +0.53 (slope 0.18) and the whole frame +0.82 (+0.87 as built, which measures the tiers: six even greys score +0.98). It is selection by brightness band. A pointwise product isn't a convolution either; it is convolution's dual under the Fourier transform. 'Literally … -flavored' contradicts itself. The same claim is in The line of iterations bullet (loose, then right in the same breath), in the Cross-Domain Resonance bullet ('[[Convolution]] — two layers multiplied into one image'), in the frontmatter link label 'multiply-blend', and on the deck's card 03. Offer: say 'brightness selects the glyph', or have the steward make 03 actually multiply.

'Temporal smoothing settles the words near-still.' Two halves. The reseed half holds whatever the noise: 03 seeds each run's words by the run's index along its row (03:209), so a run that splits, joins or appears reseeds every run to its right. The challenger counted 46% of changed letters, at smooth 0.7, sitting in runs whose start and length didn't change. The rate half needs a real measurement. In a model (the Hopper still with Gaussian cell noise), letters changing per frame at 03's default smooth of 0.7 are 8% / 16% / 27% / 36% at σ 0.005 / 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.03 (the challenger’s sweep; the piece reproduces 27% at 0.02). 03 also smooths once per display frame, not once per camera frame (03:170–185, 276): a 30 fps camera on a 60 Hz screen keeps 0.49 of the past per camera frame, not 0.7 (39% at σ 0.02). Settling it needs a few seconds of real webcam frames with someone sitting still, and card 08 holds only stills; card 10's sitting is the natural moment. Offer now: 'smoothing calms the words; a run that splits reseeds the runs to its right'. Hold the number until then.

The carried question now has a measured answer the bullet could carry: legibility is two bands of light. Drawn as 03 draws it (type 1.22 × the cell), a capital covers 0.12–0.38 of its cell (T lightest, N heaviest). Read back off the drawn Hopper frame, 5th to 95th percentile, cells holding a letter sit at 0.15–0.34 of full light, and white tiles with a letter punched in at 0.69–0.87. Across 03's word band (B 0.26 to 0.80) the drawn light stays between 0.16 and 0.22, flat. Inside the band, words picked by ink alone lift the patch match from +0.03 to +0.23. The steward got +0.17 with grammar kept (card 08), so language carries tone there, but faintly. Measured in headless Chromium's monospace font on this Mac; another font moves the numbers a little.
'Possibly its own future entry' is out of date: it is [[Language as a Tonal Medium]], as Forward Vectors already says. Offer: link it there.

Not this page's text: a sibling offer for Language as a Tonal Medium.md:46. Its step 3 says 'luminance × character-ink as a [[Convolution]]-flavored multiply', and 'a region is both the right darkness and a readable word'. Card 03 selects by light and doesn't multiply (offer 1). The 'right darkness' holds only at tier level: inside the word band, r is +0.03. That page's rich face landed 2026-10-13 with no status, so it stands approved. The offer belongs there and should be carried to it by whoever lands this one.

'The line of iterations above stops at card 03 of eight' was true on 2026-10-24. The deck now holds ten cards: card 09 (the reactive cam) and card 10 (the sitting cam) shipped 2026-11-03. Offer: 'of ten'.
